```{r}
library(here)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(tidyr)
library(Matrix)
library(svglite)
```

```{r}
dir.create(here("figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# --- Step 0 (optional): create seurat objects for all samples ---

# Loading authors' metadata 
meta_313191 <- read.csv(here("data", "GSE313191", "GSE313191_metadata.csv"))

# Creating seurat objects for each sample

samples <- c("ESC_ETiX_DD", "ESC_ETiX_DA", "ESC_ETiX_AA",
             "iGata4_ETiX_DD", "iGata4_ETiX_DA", "iGata4_ETiX_AA",
             "TSC_ETiX_DD", "TSC_ETiX_DA", "TSC_ETiX_AA")
setdiff(samples, meta_313191$title)

seurat_list <- list()
for (i in seq_len(nrow(meta_313191))) {
  gsm <- meta_313191$geo_accession[i]
  sample_name <- meta_313191$title[i]
  
  gsm_files <- list.files(here("data", "GSE313191"), pattern = gsm, full.names = TRUE)
  
  mat_file <- grep("matrix", gsm_files, value = TRUE)
  feat_file <- grep("features", gsm_files, value = TRUE)
  bc_file <- grep("barcodes", gsm_files, value = TRUE)
  
  if (length(mat_file) == 0 || length(feat_file) == 0 || length(bc_file) == 0) {
    warning(paste("Missing files for", gsm, sample_name))
    next
  }
  
  mat <- readMM(mat_file)
  features <- read.delim(feat_file, header = FALSE)
  barcodes <- read.delim(bc_file, header = FALSE)
  
  rownames(mat) <- make.unique(features$V2)
  colnames(mat) <- barcodes$V1
  
  obj <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = mat, project = sample_name)
  obj$sample_condition <- sample_name
  obj$ploidy_group <- ifelse(grepl("_DD$", sample_name), "diploid", "needs_copykat")
  
  seurat_list[[sample_name]] <- obj
}

# check cell counts per object
sapply(seurat_list, ncol)
# check Ube2h in mouse data
sapply(seurat_list, function(x) grep("Ube2h", rownames(x), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE))

# save
saveRDS(seurat_list, file = here("data", "GSE313191", "GSE313191_seurat_list_9samples.rds"))
```


```{r}
# --- Step 1: load all 9 objects ---
seurat_list_313191 <- readRDS(here("data", "GSE313191", "GSE313191_seurat_list_9samples.rds"))
names(seurat_list_313191)
```

```{r}
# --- Step 2: keep only DD and AA samples ---
keep_samples <- grep("_DD$|_AA$", names(seurat_list_313191), value = TRUE)
seurat_list_dd_aa <- seurat_list_313191[keep_samples]
names(seurat_list_dd_aa)  # should be 6: 3 lineages x (DD, AA)
```

```{r}
# --- Step 3: single-cell QC on the remaining 6 samples ---

qc_outliers <- function(x, nmads = 3, log = TRUE) {
  if (log) x <- log1p(x)
  med <- median(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  mad_val <- mad(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  x < (med - nmads * mad_val) | x > (med + nmads * mad_val)
}
 
for (s in names(seurat_list_dd_aa)) {
  obj <- seurat_list_dd_aa[[s]]
  obj[["percent.mt"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(obj, pattern = "^mt-")
 
  obj$outlier_nFeature <- qc_outliers(obj$nFeature_RNA)
  obj$outlier_nCount <- qc_outliers(obj$nCount_RNA)
  obj$outlier_mt <- qc_outliers(obj$percent.mt, log = FALSE)  # mito % - don't log-transform a percentage
  obj$outlier_any <- obj$outlier_nFeature | obj$outlier_nCount | obj$outlier_mt
 
  cat(sprintf("[%s] %d/%d cells flagged as outliers (%.1f%%)\n",
              s, sum(obj$outlier_any), ncol(obj), 100 * mean(obj$outlier_any)))
 
  seurat_list_dd_aa[[s]] <- obj
}
 
# visualizing before committing to removal
for (s in names(seurat_list_dd_aa)) {
  print(VlnPlot(seurat_list_dd_aa[[s]], features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3) +
          patchwork::plot_annotation(title = s))
}

# Thresholds set by authors of the original preprint
mt_ceiling <- 25
nfeature_min <- 500
nfeature_max <- 5000
ncount_max <- 50000

for (s in names(seurat_list_dd_aa)) {
  obj <- seurat_list_dd_aa[[s]]
  obj$outlier_paper_qc <- obj$percent.mt >= mt_ceiling |
                          obj$nFeature_RNA < nfeature_min |
                          obj$nFeature_RNA > nfeature_max |
                          obj$nCount_RNA > ncount_max

  cat(sprintf("[%s] %d/%d cells fail paper's exact QC thresholds (%.1f%%)\n",
              s, sum(obj$outlier_paper_qc), ncol(obj), 100 * mean(obj$outlier_paper_qc)))

  # actually remove the flagged cells - this line was missing
  obj <- subset(obj, subset = outlier_paper_qc == FALSE)

  seurat_list_dd_aa[[s]] <- obj
}

sapply(seurat_list_dd_aa, ncol)  # confirm counts dropped

# re-plot AFTER the actual subset, to confirm it worked
for (s in names(seurat_list_dd_aa)) {
  print(VlnPlot(seurat_list_dd_aa[[s]], features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"), ncol = 3) +
          patchwork::plot_annotation(title = s))
}

sapply(seurat_list_dd_aa, ncol)  # cell counts after QC

saveRDS(seurat_list_dd_aa, file = here("data", "GSE313191", "GSE313191_seurat_list_DD_AA_QCd.rds")) 
```

```{r}
# --- Step 4: pseudobulk - sum raw counts per gene, across all cells, per sample ---
pseudobulk_counts <- sapply(seurat_list_dd_aa, function(obj) {
  raw_counts <- GetAssayData(obj, layer = "counts")
  rowSums(raw_counts)
})
 
dim(pseudobulk_counts)  # genes x 6 pseudobulk samples
head(pseudobulk_counts)
```

```{r}
# --- Step 5: build sample metadata (lineage that was treated + condition) from sample names ---
sample_info <- data.frame(
  sample = colnames(pseudobulk_counts),
  lineage = sub("_ETiX_(DD|AA)$", "", colnames(pseudobulk_counts)),
  condition = sub(".*_ETiX_", "", colnames(pseudobulk_counts))
)
rownames(sample_info) <- sample_info$sample
sample_info$condition <- factor(sample_info$condition, levels = c("DD", "AA"))
sample_info$lineage <- factor(sample_info$lineage)
 
print(sample_info)
stopifnot(all(colnames(pseudobulk_counts) == rownames(sample_info)))
```


```{r}
# --- Step 6: DESeq2, lineage as covariate ---
dds_313191 <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = round(pseudobulk_counts),
  colData = sample_info,
  design = ~ lineage + condition
)
 
dds_313191 <- dds_313191[rowSums(counts(dds_313191)) >= 10, ]
dds_313191 <- DESeq(dds_313191)
 
resultsNames(dds_313191)
 
res_313191 <- results(dds_313191, contrast = c("condition", "AA", "DD"))
 
cat("\n=== Ube2h result (AA vs DD, pseudobulk, lineage as covariate) ===\n")
print(res_313191["Ube2h", ])
```

```{r}
# --- Volcano plot ---
 
volcano_df <- as.data.frame(res_313191)
volcano_df$gene <- rownames(volcano_df)
volcano_df <- volcano_df[!is.na(volcano_df$padj), ]
 
volcano_df$significant <- ifelse(volcano_df$padj < 0.05 & abs(volcano_df$log2FoldChange) >= 1,
                                  "Significant", "Not significant")
 
p_volcano_313191 <- ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = significant), alpha = 0.4, size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Significant" = "#d64545", "Not significant" = "grey75")) +
  geom_point(data = volcano_df[volcano_df$gene == "Ube2h", ],
             color = "#1f4fd6", size = 3.5) +
  geom_text_repel(data = volcano_df[volcano_df$gene == "Ube2h", ],
                   aes(label = gene), color = "#1f4fd6", fontface = "bold",
                   nudge_y = 3, size = 4.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 75)) +
  labs(
    title = "GSE313191: pseudobulk AA vs DD",
    subtitle = "Lineage-adjusted (design = ~ lineage + condition), n = 3 lineages per condition",
    x = expression(log[2]*" fold change"),
    y = expression(-log[10]*"(adjusted p-value)"),
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey30"),
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_volcano_313191)
ggsave(here("figures", "GSE313191_pseudobulk_volcano.png"), p_volcano_313191, width = 7.5, height = 6.5, dpi = 600)
ggsave(here("figures", "GSE313191_pseudobulk_volcano.svg"), p_volcano_313191, width = 7.5, height = 6.5)
```

```{r}
# --- Per-lineage DD vs AA paired comparison (n=1 per group, so points + connecting lines) ---
 
norm_counts_313191 <- counts(dds_313191, normalized = TRUE)
ube2h_norm_313191 <- norm_counts_313191["Ube2h", ]
 
ube2h_df_313191 <- data.frame(
  sample = names(ube2h_norm_313191),
  ube2h = ube2h_norm_313191
) %>%
  left_join(sample_info, by = "sample")
 
p_lineage_313191 <- ggplot(ube2h_df_313191, aes(x = condition, y = ube2h, group = lineage, color = lineage)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("ESC" = "#d64545", "iGata4" = "#4573d6", "TSC" = "#e8a33d")) +
  labs(
    title = "Ube2h expression: DD vs AA, by lineage",
    subtitle = sprintf("GSE313191 pseudobulk | padj = %.3f (lineage-adjusted)", res_313191["Ube2h", "padj"]),
    x = NULL, y = "Ube2h normalized count", color = "Lineage"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey30"),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
 
print(p_lineage_313191)
ggsave(here("figures", "GSE313191_pseudobulk_UBE2H_by_lineage.png"), p_lineage_313191, width = 6.5, height = 6, dpi = 600)
ggsave(here("figures", "GSE313191_pseudobulk_UBE2H_by_lineage.svg"), p_lineage_313191, width = 6.5, height = 6)
```
